svg.text: From a point cloud to a graph to communities
each cell connects to its k = 5 nearest cells
edge weight = how many neighbours two cells share
(thick = same neighbourhood, thin = just passing by)
Leiden cuts the graph where edges are sparse:
dense inside, few edges between = a community
Analogy: kNN is each person's friends list; SNN weights friendships by mutual friends; Leiden finds friend groups. UMAP later draws this same social
